articles.desc: Auckland-based property technology company Valocity has secured the biggest deal in its history on the first day of the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA), New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said. Highlighting the agreement's potential to boost business opportunities, Luxon said the trade pact would help New Zealand companies expand overseas while creating jobs and raising incomes at home.

articles.title: How is the US economy really doing under President Trump?
articles.desc: Ahead of the midterms Trump has boasted about the performance of the US economy. BBC Verify looks at inflation, jobs and economic growth in the country.
